channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro exibe dados de favoritismo da escala 5x2 em reuniăo, mas aponta ressalvas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the presidency of Brazil, met with party legislators to align communication strategy in his defense in the Vorcaro case and demanded data showing popular support for ending the 6x1 work schedule, citing favorability toward the alternative 5x2 model.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro năo para de mentir, PL finge que acredita e centrăo faz cara de paisagem
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy is described as being 'in profit' by PL allies, as his early pre-campaign performance exceeded expectations, tying with President Lula in very early polls. This positions him favorably for the 2026 elections, according to party sources.

item.title: Prefeitura de SP fechou patrocínio de R$ 2,5 mi ŕ ONG ligada a 'Dark Horse'
item.description: The São Paulo City Hall signed a R$2.5 million sponsorship contract for an event organized by the ICB (Instituto Conhecer Brasil), linked to Karina Ferreira da Gama, executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse' about former President Jair Bolsonaro. The agreement raises concerns about the use of public funds to support projects associated with controversial political figures.

item.title: Flávio ouve gritos de ‘Vorcaro’ e ‘rachadinha’ em evento
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was heckled during the 27th March of Mayors in Brasília, with chants of 'Vorcaro' and 'rachadinha' directed at him, referencing his alleged ties to businessman Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The incident reflects the negative impact of investigations into alleged illegal financial schemes involving his family on public perception.

item.title: Conselho de Ética analisa nesta quarta-feira ação contra bolsonarista que xingou Motta
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council will review on Wednesday a complaint against bolsonarist deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS), who insulted Chamber President Hugo Motta, calling him 'a fuck' and 'a shit' during a rally in Campo Grande in August 2025. Rapporteur Ricardo Maia (MDB-BA) reduced the proposed suspension of Pollon's mandate from 90 to 60 days. The vote was postponed from Tuesday to Wednesday.

item.title: Cotada para vice de Flávio, deputada se define como “pacificadora”
item.description: Federal deputy Simone Marquetto (PP-SP) is being considered as a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the 2026 elections. During a lunch in Campinas (SP), she described herself as a center-right politician and a 'pacifist', stating she engages with politicians across the ideological spectrum, from PT to PL. The meeting took place shortly after reports emerged that Flávio Bolsonaro had requested money from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: AtlasIntel se manifesta após reclamação da equipe de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: AtlasIntel released a document detailing the methodology of its survey that assessed public reaction to leaked conversations between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, following a PL challenge to the TSE over the poll’s integrity. The survey showed Lula leading Bolsonaro in both the first and second rounds. The firm defended that the audio test was conducted after the main questionnaire, with no contamination, and under rigorous technical and scientific standards.

item.title: Reajuste de piso dos professores vai ao plenário da Câmara
item.description: The mixed committee approved a 5.4% increase in the national minimum salary for basic education teachers, raising it from R$ 4,867.77 to R$ 5,130.63, with annual adjustments based on INPC and Fundeb revenues. The measure will be voted on in the Chamber plenary this Wednesday (May 20, 2026), following Senate approval, and must be enacted by June 1 to avoid expiration.

item.title: Centrão avalia que visita a Vorcaro põe Flávio em situação delicada e vê 'ponta do iceberg'
item.description: Centrist party leaders say Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to banker Daniel Vorcaro, after Vorcaro's first arrest in 2025, worsened his already fragile position as a presidential candidate. The revelation is seen as merely the 'tip of the iceberg' of potentially problematic connections. Flávio Bolsonaro's precarious situation increases pressure on his candidacy in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai analisar ação de Flávio Bolsonaro contra divulgação de pesquisa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques will analyze a lawsuit filed by the PL party and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against pollster AtlasIntel, which released a survey showing declining voting intentions for the senator following the release of audio recordings revealing his ties to Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master. The defense claims the survey induces a negative perception, but AtlasIntel states the audio was played only after the questionnaire was completed, thus not influencing initial responses. The poll, registered with the TSE under code BR-06939/2026, was the first released after Intercept Brasil’s reports on the Bolsonaro clan’s relationship with Vorcaro.

item.title: Após abusar do silêncio, Flávio exagera no uso do conta-gotas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, initially positioned as an 'arrow' in the 2026 presidential campaign, failed to prepare for becoming a target of criticism. After a strategic silence that turned into noisy evasion, he adopted a disorganized and damaging approach to managing the crisis triggered by revelations of his promiscuous financial relationship with Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 69% e desaprovado por 25% no PI, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll released on May 19, 2026 shows that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has 69% approval and 25% disapproval in Piauí, with 5% undecided. The government's performance is rated 'good' or 'excellent' by 64.0% of voters in the state. The survey interviewed 1,240 people between May 13 and 18, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Motta diz querer aprovar regulamentação da 6 X 1 antes das eleições
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta said he wants to approve complementary bills to the 6x1 workweek reduction PEC before the 2026 elections. He stated the PEC will be streamlined, focusing on reducing the weekly workweek without salary cuts, while the complementary bills will define sector-specific rules. The Chamber will adopt a 'concentrated effort' regime to vote on the proposal next week, with rapporteur Leo Prates presenting his report on May 20.

item.title: AtlasIntel reproduziu áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro em pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: AtlasIntel reproduced audio allegedly showing Flávio Bolsonaro requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro in its latest electoral poll, prompting the PL party to challenge the survey at the TSE over alleged voter inducement. The poll, conducted between May 13–18 with 5,032 respondents, shows Lula leading in the first round (47% vs 34.3%) and second round (48.9% vs 41.8%) against Bolsonaro. AtlasIntel defended its methodology, stating the audio was played only at the end of data collection and that it plans to use Lula’s audio in future surveys.

item.title: Lula tem 71,5% e Flávio, 22,2% no 2º turno no PI, diz pesquisa
item.description: According to an AtlasIntel poll released on May 19, 2026, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads with 71.5% of voting intentions against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (22.2%) in a hypothetical second-round scenario in Piauí. The survey, conducted between May 13 and 18 among 1,240 voters, has a margin of error of 3 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. The study followed the release of an audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro reportedly asked Daniel Vorcaro for money.

item.title: Os detalhes da reação dos eleitores ao áudio de Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo a AtlasIntel
item.description: The AtlasIntel study on voter reaction to Flávio Bolsonaro's audio reveals that while the content was perceived as slightly positive (average above 0.4 on a 0 to 1 scale), it alienated non-aligned voters, retaining only the support of the 'hard core'. The institute attributes this to the resilience of political polarization in Brazil, with negative impacts limited to those already opposed to bolsonarism. Although the VRC-based survey did not affect overall voting intention numbers, it was targeted for suspension by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign before the TSE.

item.title: O resultado da contestada pesquisa da AtlasIntel com o uso de áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll revealed that Flávio Bolsonaro's audio message to Daniel Vorcaro generated a generally negative perception (0.41 on a 0 to 1 scale), although among Jair Bolsonaro 2022 voters the evaluation was more positive (0.58). Meanwhile, higher-income voters and those who cast blank or null ballots in 2022 were especially critical. In the main voting intention poll, Flávio dropped from 39.7% to 34.3%, while Lula remained stable at 47%.

item.title: Produtora diz que filme de Bolsonaro já custou R$ 65,7 milhões; 90% do gasto foi bancado por Vorcaro
item.description: The producer GoUp states that the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, has already cost R$ 65.7 million, with over 90% of the budget coming from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, imprisoned for billion-dollar frauds. Flávio Bolsonaro admits receiving over US$ 12 million from Vorcaro for the film, though the producer claims funds came from the Heavengate fund, linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro, and that Vorcaro acted only as an intermediary. The Federal Police are investigating whether the money was diverted to support Eduardo Bolsonaro, who lives in self-imposed exile in the U.S. with assets frozen by the STF.

item.title: Moro questiona troca de delegado da PF em investigação sobre fraudes no INSS
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) criticized the replacement of Federal Police delegate Guilherme Figueiredo Silva, who was leading investigations into INSS fraud involving suspicions related to President Lula's son. Moro stated the change occurred without public justification or prior notice to Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, the case's rapporteur, comparing it to Operation Car Wash and warning it would provoke public outrage. The opposition plans to summon the PF director-general to Congress for explanations.

item.title: Petistas vêem propaganda eleitoral e vão ao TSE para impedir estreia de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Petitioners from the Workers' Party filed a request with the TSE to ban the screening of 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro funded by Daniel Vorcaro following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing it constitutes illegal pre-campaign advertising. The plea also demands an investigation into the film's financing, citing evidence of money laundering and the use of offshore structures to conceal the source of funds.

item.title: Oposição tenta ofuscar escândalo do Master com redução da maioridade penal; governo evita debate
item.description: The opposition is attempting to use the proposal to reduce the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 years to overshadow the Master scandal and boost Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential campaign. The government and allies of Chamber President Hugo Motta are avoiding debate on the PEC in the CCJ due to fears of negative backlash or inflaming radicalism, despite believing it would likely pass. The proposal was postponed due to the start of the plenary session, and Motta’s allies say it will not be voted on before the elections to prevent exacerbating polarization.

item.title: Edinho fala em recuo de Pacheco, mas decisão depende de Lula
item.description: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) is awaiting a meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) to decide whether to run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026. Although PT president Edinho Silva claimed Pacheco had withdrawn his candidacy, the final decision hinges on the upcoming meeting with Lula, which will determine the conditions for his potential entry into the race. The PT is already exploring alternatives due to Pacheco’s possible reluctance, given Minas Gerais’ status as a key bellwether state in national elections.

item.title: Motta diz que Câmara vai votar o fim da escala 6×1 na próxima semana
item.description: Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies Hugo Motta announced that the constitutional amendment to end the 6×1 work schedule will be voted on next week, following a committee vote. He said he will seek a 'convergence text' with rapporteur Léo Prates and productive sector representatives, ensuring reduced working hours without salary cuts and two days off.

item.title: Rejeitado ao STF, Messias aparece ao lado de Lula em SP
item.description: Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union, whose nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by President Lula was rejected by the Senate, interrupted his vacation to attend a public event alongside the president in São Paulo. According to Folha de S.Paulo, his presence next to Lula was not coincidental, signaling a government effort to project political unity following the STF nomination setback.

item.title: É preciso explicar a origem do dinheiro que o senador Flávio Bolsonaro apanhou com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: The text questions the origin of the money Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received from banker Daniel Vorcaro, emphasizing that as a pre-presidential candidate, he must explain not only the receipt but also the source of the funds and why a businessman would hand over large sums without clear compensation. It argues that labeling the payments as a 'private business' is inadequate given the public nature of the office and suspicions of illicit financing, especially after Vorcaro's arrest and the secrecy surrounding the transactions.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Após vazamento de áudios, Flávio despenca 6% em pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro dropped six percentage points in an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll in a hypothetical second-round scenario against President Lula, following the leak of messages he sent to banker Daniel Vorcaro. The incident sparked significant backlash and negatively affected his standing in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sugere pagamento por hora em alternativa à escala 6x1
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed flexibilizing the CLT to allow hourly wage payment as an alternative to ending the 6x1 work schedule, arguing it preserves labor rights and adapts to technological changes. He labeled the federal government’s proposal to reduce the workweek to 40 hours as opportunistic and electoral, claiming it would cause mass unemployment and raise living costs.

item.title: CNT diz ver com 'preocupação' pacote de Lula para motoristas de app
item.description: The CNT expressed concern over the federal government's R$ 30 billion credit package for light vehicle purchases under Lula, stating it is monitoring the initiative closely due to potential impacts on the transportation sector.

item.title: Esquerda usa encontro com Vorcaro, áudio de Mario Frias e trailer de 'Dark Horse' como artilharia contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Brazilian left-wing lawmakers intensified criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after he confirmed a meeting with detained banker Daniel Vorcaro. PT, PSOL, and government allies cited an audio clip of federal deputy Mario Frias thanking Vorcaro for financing the film 'Dark Horse' and the film’s trailer as evidence of suspicious ties, accusing the Bolsonaro family of lying about their relationship with the banker and suggesting possible interference in ongoing investigations.

item.title: Gilmar derruba decisão do TRE e libera posts de Zeca Dirceu que acusam Dallagnol de tentar desvio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes overturned a Paraná Electoral Court order to remove posts by federal deputy Zeca Dirceu (PT) accusing former deputy Deltan Dallagnol of attempting to divert R$ 2 billion in Operation Car Wash and of being ineligible for 8 years. Mendes ruled the statements are protected under freedom of expression, based on public documents and final judgments from the TSE and CNJ, and do not constitute misinformation or censorship.

item.title: Entenda quais fatores frustram os investidores nesta terça-feira
item.description: Global markets are operating under risk aversion due to uncertainty in U.S.-Iran negotiations, with Brent crude oil priced at around $111 and the dollar above 5 reais, reflecting inflationary fears and expectations of prolonged restrictive U.S. interest rates. In Brazil, the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro by nearly 13 points in the first round (47.0% to 34.3%) and 7 points in a potential runoff (48.9% to 41.8%), disappointing investors who anticipated a government change and fiscal reforms. The Ibovespa fell more than 1.5% amid this unfavorable domestic and international backdrop.

item.title: Neto Carletto é eleito presidente da Comissão de Administração e Serviço Público da Câmara
item.description: Deputy Neto Carletto (Avante-BA) was elected president of the Chamber of Deputies' Administration and Public Service Committee with 13 votes, in his first term. He stated he aims to develop excellent work, with rapporteurship and authorship of important projects on relevant Brazilian societal issues. Deputy Delegada Ione (PL-MG) resigned the presidency and became the committee's 3rd vice-president.

item.title: Ibovespa recua mais de 1% com cenário eleitoral no Brasil e tensões no Oriente Médio
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.52% on Tuesday to 174,200 points, driven by risk aversion due to Middle East tensions and new electoral polls in Brazil. Major banks including Itaú, Bradesco, Banco do Brasil and Santander closed lower, while the dollar rose above 5 reais.

item.title: TSE deve barrar ação de advogados contra exibição do filme sobre Bolsonaro na campanha
item.description: The TSE is expected to dismiss without review a lawsuit seeking to block the screening of the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro during the 2026 election campaign, due to lack of standing by the plaintiffs. The film, a biopic of the former president and father of Flávio Bolsonaro — a pre-candidate for president — is expected to be released in September and allegedly constitutes economic power abuse and improper media use, according to the Prerrogativas group and federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG).

item.title: O papelão do PT em debate sobre a PEC da redução de maioridade penal na CCJ
item.description: The PT chose not to participate in the CCJ debate on the PEC to reduce the age of criminal responsibility, leaving PSOL as the sole party obstructing the measure. PT lawmakers justified their absence by expecting a vista request that would delay the vote, which did not materialize, but admitted their presence would have made obstruction easier. Allies outside the PT called the move a 'farce,' suggesting the party avoided confrontation to not alienate centrist voters who support the measure, despite its base opposing it.

item.title: PT apostará na pecha de 'Flávio mentiroso' para enfraquecer senador frente a indecisos
item.description: The PT is leveraging contradictions in Flávio Bolsonaro's statements about his meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro during house arrest to build a 'liar' narrative in his pre-campaign. The strategy, led by the party's communications team, aims to exploit videos and social media clips to undermine the senator's credibility among undecided voters, especially after he attempted to link the Lula government to Vorcaro.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra que 51% dos brasileiros querem mulher no STF
item.description: A Datafolha poll from May 2026 reveals that 51% of Brazilians consider it very important for the next STF minister to be a woman, and 46% prioritize appointing a Black person, reflecting public demand for greater diversity on the Court. Meanwhile, 85% emphasize notable legal knowledge as crucial, 64% expect justices to be independent of politicians and parties, and 51% value loyalty to the appointing president, highlighting a tension between technical merit and political considerations. The study also notes opinion differences between Lula voters and others, though specific breakdowns by voting intention are not detailed in the excerpt.

item.title: Reação de Moro após Flávio Bolsonaro admitir visita a Vorcaro viraliza. Veja vídeo
item.description: During a press conference, Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) displayed a serious and distant reaction upon hearing Flávio Bolsonaro admit to having met with banker Daniel Vorcaro after his house arrest in December 2023. The video went viral, with left-leaning pages using it to criticize Moro, who reapproached Bolsonarism after joining the PL in March 2026 and is a pre-candidate for governor of Paraná. Flávio’s admission contradicts his prior denials of knowing Vorcaro, a relationship previously exposed by The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro aciona o TSE contra a pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's lawyers filed a complaint with the TSE challenging an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in his voting intentions, claiming the survey's methodology was designed to induce negative perceptions by linking him to alleged financial misconduct involving Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro. They demand the poll's suspension, a fine for the firm, and an investigation for alleged electoral crimes, arguing the use of unverified audio and leading questions undermines the poll's neutrality and turns it into indirect negative propaganda.

item.title: Governo Lula promete fim de idade mínima e de curso obrigatório para entregadores de delivery
item.description: The Lula government announced the end of the theoretical course requirement and the 21-year minimum age for delivery workers, while launching the 'Move Brasil' program offering subsidized vehicle financing for taxi and app-based drivers with at least 100 rides per year. The measures include lower interest rates, vehicle ownership for workers, and mandatory rest stops for truck drivers on all Brazilian highways.

item.title: Atlas traz boas notícias para Lula, mas rejeição ainda preocupa aliados
item.description: The Atlas poll shows Lula with a comfortable lead over Flávio Bolsonaro after the senator’s voting intentions dropped from 39.7% in April to 34.3% in May, while Lula rose slightly from 46.6% to 47%. In the runoff scenario, Lula’s advantage shifted from a technical tie to a 7-point lead (48.9% to 41.8%). Perception of the Master scandal also reversed: now 43.3% link the scheme to Bolsonaro’s allies, up from 28.3%, while those linking it to Lula’s allies fell to 32.8% from 39.5%.

item.title: Neta de Lula dará curso sobre redes sociais para militância do PT
item.description: Bia Lula da Silva, the eldest granddaughter of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and a communications specialist, plans to contribute to her grandfather's 2026 re-election campaign by teaching social media strategies to PT militants. The initiative is part of Pode Espalhar, the official digital militia network of the Workers' Party (PT) in partnership with the Perseu Abramo Foundation, aiming to train influencers and militants as 'Lula's spokespersons' to share government-aligned content and counter disinformation online.

item.title: Governo pede derrubada da Lei da Dosimetria no Supremo
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (AGU) has asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to declare the Dosimetry Law unconstitutional, which was passed by Congress after overturning President Lula's veto. The AGU argues the law unjustifiably reduces penalties for crimes like coup attempts and violent abolition of the democratic state, undermining democratic order. Minister Alexandre de Moraes has suspended the law's application pending a full court ruling, requiring input from Congress and the PGR.

item.title: Boulos critica medidas de Tarcísio direcionadas a motofretistas
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol-SP) criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicanos) measures requiring mandatory training, red plates, and a minimum age of 21 for motorcycle couriers, stating the Lula government aims to reduce bureaucracy. He announced the Move Aplicativos program, with up to R$ 30 billion from the National Treasury, to finance new vehicles for 1.2 to 1.4 million app-based workers, offering interest rates below the Selic and preferential terms for women.

item.title: Mendonça cobra Justiça de SP em processo contra Silvio Almeida por importunação sexual
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça has notified São Paulo’s 5th Federal Court to demand explanations for the lack of defense by former Human Rights Minister Silvio Almeida in a sexual harassment case brought by Anielle Franco. Mendonça had previously given Almeida a 15-day deadline to respond after the PGR pointed to evidence, including Federal Police testimonies about Franco’s emotional state. The case, under seal, may proceed to a decision on whether Almeida becomes a defendant in the Second Chamber of the STF.

item.title: Lula aproveitou reunião para enviar recado a Trump sobre terras raras
item.description: President Lula sent a message to the U.S. and other global powers regarding Brazil's rare earths exploration, emphasizing that the country is open to foreign investment as long as it respects national sovereignty and economic interests. The statement was made by Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira following a meeting with Serra Verde Group CEO Thras Moraitis, highlighting the government's goal to leverage mineral wealth for industrial and technological development, not just raw material exports.

item.title: 'Assombração sabe para quem aparece', diz Zema em meio à repercussão de encontro entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, Novo's pre-candidate for presidency, stated he never had contact with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master under investigation for fiscal fraud, saying 'haunting knows who to appear to', in reference to Flávio Bolsonaro's confirmed meeting with the banker. Zema previously called Flávio's attitude 'imperdoável' but adopted a more restrained tone after backlash, reiterating he never met Vorcaro despite living nearby. The controversy arises amid the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', a biography of Jair Bolsonaro, whose trailer was released this Tuesday.

item.title: Lula anuncia R$ 30 bilhões em crédito para motoristas de aplicativos e taxistas financiarem carro novo
item.description: President Lula announced a Provisional Measure allocating up to R$ 30 billion in credit for ride-hailing drivers and taxi drivers to finance new car purchases at lower interest rates, under the Move Brazil program. Eligibility requires at least 12 months of active registration and 100 rides for app drivers, or active registration for taxi drivers, and applies to new vehicles up to R$ 150,000 meeting sustainability criteria (flex, hybrid flex, electric, or ethanol-only). Conditions will be even more favorable for women, including lower interest rates, longer terms, and financing for additional safety equipment.

item.title: Flávio diz que CLT está ultrapassada e propõe alternativa à escala 6 X 1
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the proposal to end the 6x1 work scale, stating that the CLT is outdated and advocating for an alternative based on hourly pay, with proportional maintenance of rights such as FGTS, vacation pay, and 13th salary. He warned that reducing the workweek could lead to mass unemployment and higher living costs, calling the PEC an 'easy solution' with electoral bias. The PL bloc will present its proposal, aiming to flexibilize the labor market and facilitate the entry of single mothers into formal employment.

item.title: “Dark Horse” deve passar por auditoria de valores nesta quarta-feira
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', based on the biography of Jair Bolsonaro, will undergo a financial audit on Wednesday, the 20th, according to PL sources under anonymity. The hearing will present financial data related to the production, although Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet officially confirmed the information.
